test: harness shell tests > bin/tests/wave-gate-lock.test.sh exits 0 with an empty HOME
reason: Under Git Bash on the loaded GitHub Windows runner a case of harness/bin/tests/wave-gate-lock.test.sh that needs a killed wave-gate's pid to stay dead fails now and then: Windows hands the freed pid to a new process within seconds, and the next run takes it for a live holder ("another wave-gate check runs in this repository (pid 940)", case "e2e lock of a killed run", PR run 40615971705). The twins and token cases, red in CI runs 40607908878 and 40562890010, got a pid no system hands out in the same PR; the killed-run case needs the real pid. Green in 15 other Windows runs of 2026-10-27/28.
